name: Edda of Heroes
body:
Requirement: Perform 20 ranks; two among Centering Chant, Impervious Melody, and Strengthening Drone.

Base effect: All allies within 30 feet gain a +6 enhancement bonus to all ability scores, DR 5/– and a +1 bonus to their caster level.

Refrain

You imbue an essence of immortality in your allies, saving them from the brink of death.

Weak Refrain: One ally within 30 feet is healed as for the heal spell, as if cast at caster level 20th.

Intermediate Refrain: All allies within 30 feet recover 10d8+60 hit points.

Strong refrain: All allies within 30 feet are healed as for the mass heal spell, as if cast at caster level 20.
